acceptance.source: docs/design-language.md and the approved localhost specimen brief
outcomes: Astro renders a substantial monochrome portfolio and design-system specimen.
Product accents remain scoped to product identity and action roles.
The design profile stays machine-readable and deterministically validated.
invariants: The prototype remains static and performs no Neon or production writes.
The base palette remains black, white, and gray.
Product accents do not become generic semantic status colors.
forbiddenOutcomes: SSR, database access, external deployment, or secret use is introduced by the prototype.
Visual readiness is reported without rendered review.
